reason: Primary purpose is external knowledge search support for plugin development workflows: the plugin exposes `github_search` and `npm_search` tools plus an optional prompt rule to guide agents to search existing projects first before creating new capabilities.

summaries.zh: 这是一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件，提供 GitHub 与 npm 的结构化检索工具，并可在代理开发新能力前先执行搜索，帮助用户先发现可复用的现有项目。
summaries.en: This is a DeepSeek Harness plugin that provides structured GitHub and npm search tools, and can guide an agent to search existing projects before building new functionality.

capabilities: Performs GitHub repository searches via GitHub Search API
Performs npm package searches via npm search API
Provides structured query inputs and outputs (name, stars, description, language, etc.)
Adds an optional agent guidance rule to require search-before-build checks

reasons.code: README documents `github_search` as a structured GitHub repo search tool using GitHub Search API with fields and sorting.
README documents `npm_search` as structured npm package search, including support for npm qualifiers like `keywords:dsh-plugin`.
README documents `guidePrompt` (default on) as a rule requiring agents to call search tools before writing a new plugin or capability.
Package metadata and scripts indicate this is a dsh plugin package with no source showing local destructive operations in the provided evidence.
